assertions.rationale: The agent did not update the reservation at all; they transferred the customer to a human agent without completing the modification. Additionally, the flights the agent found and discussed were HAT227 (ATL→ORD) and HAT139 (ORD→PHL), not HAT110 and HAT172.

assertions.assertion: Agent uses the payment id: gift_card_8887175
assertions.rationale: The agent never used gift_card_8887175 as a payment method for any modification. They explicitly stated they could not complete the change because no valid payment/refund method was available, and then transferred the customer to a human agent.

summary: The agent did not update the reservation or use the specified payment ID; they transferred the customer to a human agent without completing the modification.
